---
title: "Models"
---

Filter this catalogue by **model type**, **management context**, **province or territory**, **availability**, **output type**, whether it has **tools to help run it**, or a **species keyword**. This registry is a starting point, not the authoritative source: models change over time and entries here are updated only periodically, so use the model website and repository links to confirm current details. The species search matches text, not a standardized species taxonomy; species lists are general summaries, so no match does not prove a model excludes a species. Jurisdiction matches refer only to recorded coverage, which can be limited to a region, ecosystem, or US state noted for that jurisdiction; read each coverage entry before interpreting a match as geographic applicability. When an entry covers multiple model versions, a filter match may describe only one version; check the model notes and link titles before applying it to another version.

```{=html}
<div class="row g-2 mb-3" id="catalogue-filters">
  <div class="col-md-3">
    <label for="model-type-filter">Model type</label>
    <select id="model-type-filter" class="form-select"><option value="">All types</option></select>
  </div>
  <div class="col-md-3">
    <label for="management-context-filter">Management context</label>
    <select id="management-context-filter" class="form-select"><option value="">All contexts</option></select>
  </div>
  <div class="col-md-3">
    <label for="jurisdiction-filter">Coverage jurisdiction</label>
    <select id="jurisdiction-filter" class="form-select"><option value="">All jurisdictions</option></select>
  </div>
  <div class="col-md-3">
    <label for="species-filter">Species keyword</label>
    <input id="species-filter" class="form-control" type="search" placeholder="e.g., spruce">
  </div>
  <div class="col-md-3">
    <label for="output-type-filter">Output type</label>
    <select id="output-type-filter" class="form-select"><option value="">All output types</option></select>
  </div>
  <div class="col-md-3">
    <label for="availability-filter">Availability</label>
    <select id="availability-filter" class="form-select"><option value="">All availability</option></select>
  </div>
  <div class="col-md-3 d-flex align-items-end">
    <div class="form-check">
      <input id="has-tools-filter" class="form-check-input" type="checkbox">
      <label class="form-check-label" for="has-tools-filter">Has tools to help run it</label>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<p id="catalogue-count" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

library(htmltools)
source("R/registry.R")
source("R/site_helpers.R")

models <- read_registry_table("models")
coverage <- read_registry_table("model_coverage")
links <- read_registry_table("model_links")

link_details <- function(resources) {
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(resources)), function(i) {
    resource <- resources[i, ]
    tags$li(
      tags$a(href = resource$url, resource$title, rel = "noopener noreferrer"),
      if (is_github_link(resource$url)) github_badge() else NULL
    )
  })
}

# Grouped sub-sections of a model's links, in the order defined by link_group_spec.
link_sections <- function(resources) {
  groups <- group_model_links(resources)
  tagList(lapply(groups, function(group) {
    tagList(tags$h4(group$label), tags$ul(tagList(link_details(group$rows))))
  }))
}

model_cards <- lapply(order(models$model_id), function(i) {
  model <- models[i, ]
  id <- model$model_id[[1]]
  claims <- coverage[coverage$model_id == id, , drop = FALSE]
  resources <- links[links$model_id == id, , drop = FALSE]

  model_details <- tags$details(
    tags$summary("Model details"),
    tags$ul(
      field("Developers", model$developers),
      field("Contributors", model$contributors),
      field("Organization", model$organization),
      field("Model type", model$model_type),
      field("Programming language", model$programming_language),
      field("Availability", gsub("_", " ", model$availability)),
      field("Interface", gsub("_", " ", model$interface)),
      field("Output types", gsub("_", " ", model$output_types)),
      field("Species", model$species),
      field("Minimum inputs", model$minimum_inputs),
      field("Outputs", model$outputs),
      field("Silvicultural interventions", model$management_options),
      field("Other features", model$other_features),
      field("Management context", model$management_context),
      field("Notes", model$notes),
      field("Last reviewed", model$last_reviewed)
    )
  )

  claim_details <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(claims)), function(i) {
    claim <- claims[i, ]
    tags$li(
      tags$strong(paste0(
        shown(claim$jurisdiction_code),
        if (!is.na(claim$region_detail) && nzchar(claim$region_detail)) {
          paste0(" (", claim$region_detail, ")")
        } else {
          ""
        }
      )),
      tags$ul(field("Stand scope", claim$stand_scope))
    )
  })

  tags$article(
    class = "card mb-3 model-card",
    `data-type` = paste(na.omit(model$model_type), collapse = "|"),
    `data-context` = paste(na.omit(model$management_context), collapse = "|"),
    `data-jurisdiction` = paste(unique(claims$jurisdiction_code[
      !is.na(claims$jurisdiction_code)
    ]), collapse = "|"),
    `data-species` = paste(na.omit(model$species), collapse = " "),
    `data-outputs` = paste(split_multi(model$output_types), collapse = "|"),
    `data-availability` = paste(na.omit(model$availability), collapse = "|"),
    `data-has-tools` = if (any(resources$link_type == "run_tool")) "yes" else "no",
    tags$div(
      class = "card-body",
      tags$h2(class = "card-title", id = id, shown(model$model_name)),
      tags$p("Model ID: ", id),
      tags$h3("Model information"),
      model_details,
      tags$h3("Geographic coverage"),
      if (nrow(claims) > 0) tags$ul(tagList(claim_details)) else tags$p("Not recorded"),
      tags$h3("Model websites, related documents/tools and downloads"),
      if (nrow(resources) > 0) link_sections(resources) else tags$p("Not recorded")
    )
  )
})

cat("```{=html}\n", as.character(tagList(model_cards)), "\n```\n", sep = "")
```

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll(".model-card")];
  const type = document.getElementById("model-type-filter");
  const context = document.getElementById("management-context-filter");
  const jurisdiction = document.getElementById("jurisdiction-filter");
  const species = document.getElementById("species-filter");
  const outputType = document.getElementById("output-type-filter");
  const availability = document.getElementById("availability-filter");
  const hasTools = document.getElementById("has-tools-filter");
  const count = document.getElementById("catalogue-count");

  for (const [select, key] of [
    [type, "type"], [context, "context"], [jurisdiction, "jurisdiction"],
    [outputType, "outputs"], [availability, "availability"]
  ]) {
    const values = new Set(cards.flatMap(card => card.dataset[key].split("|").filter(Boolean)));
    for (const value of [...values].sort()) {
      select.add(new Option(value.replaceAll("_", " "), value));
    }
  }

  function filterCards() {
    let visible = 0;
    for (const card of cards) {
      const matches = [
        [type, "type"], [context, "context"], [jurisdiction, "jurisdiction"],
        [outputType, "outputs"], [availability, "availability"]
      ].every(([select, key]) =>
        !select.value || card.dataset[key].split("|").includes(select.value)
      );
      const speciesMatch = card.dataset.species.toLocaleLowerCase()
        .includes(species.value.trim().toLocaleLowerCase());
      const toolsMatch = !hasTools.checked || card.dataset.hasTools === "yes";
      card.hidden = !(matches && speciesMatch && toolsMatch);
      if (!card.hidden) visible++;
    }
    count.textContent = `${visible} of ${cards.length} models shown`;
  }

  for (const input of [type, context, jurisdiction, species, outputType, availability, hasTools]) {
    input.addEventListener("input", filterCards);
  }
  filterCards();
});
</script>
```
